create.name: Desirée Dunbar
create.bio:
Desirée Dunbar is a dancer, choreographer and creative mentor based in Vancouver, Canada, and the founder of The Secret Garden Society, an online community for women. She holds an MFA in dance, performed and made contemporary work for many years and later taught movement at university level. Over time her teaching moved from the stage towards women going through big changes in life, such as a shift in career, family or sense of self, who feel that something new is asking to come through.

Her approach brings together dance and embodied movement, ritual, intuition, guided meditation and down-to-earth mentoring. She draws on earth-based ceremony, the cycles of the moon and feminine myth, including a long interest in Mary Magdalene, and treats creativity as a way of listening to oneself rather than a luxury. Her main programme, Charmed, is a year-long group journey of live movement rituals, reflective practices and workbooks, and she also runs CRAFT, a small six-month mastermind for women bringing a project or business into being. Her YouTube channel carries guided visualisations and conversations with members, and her meditations on Insight Timer are free to hear.

courses.title: Charmed
courses.description: Desirée's year-long online group journey for women in a time of change, built on movement, ritual, intuitive practice and creative exploration. Members join live monthly circles, which are recorded, and work with guided workbooks. Doors open seasonally, with a waiting list in between.

courses.title: CRAFT
courses.description: A small six-month mastermind for women who want to bring a business, body of work or creative project into being. It mixes group mentoring with structure and encouragement to keep moving, and applications open first to the waiting list.

free_resources.title: Desirée Dunbar on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A small set of longer guided meditations from Desirée, drawing on ritual, the goddess Saraswati and ancestral remembrance. Free to listen in the app or on the web.
